lastCompletedStory.title: Inject a worker-actor env marker into the spawned implementer worker (host + container)

nextStoryContext: US-002 added a worker-actor CAM_WORKER=1 marker, positive-SET (not an unset), on BOTH dispatch paths: buildImplementerWorkerArgv (src/supervisor/worker-argv.ts) appends `CAM_WORKER=1 ` after workerEnvPrefix(isolation) and before `claude` -- exported as WORKER_ACTOR_ENV, deliberately NOT folded into the shared workerEnvPrefix() (which review.ts and plan-argv.ts also call for the reviewer/planner workers, and those must never carry the marker); buildDockerRunArgv (src/supervisor/worker-container.ts) adds a literal `-e CAM_WORKER=1` pair alongside the existing containerEnv `-e` pairs (NOT the name-only credential form, since it is not a secret). The marker is inert: nothing reads it yet. US-006 (depends on US-002) is expected to extend the write-allowlist hook to deny a worker-actor Write to prd.json using this marker, distinguishing it from the planner/orchestrator session (which also runs under CAM_SESSION and legitimately writes prd.json, and is launched via a different path -- src/tmux/session.ts `new-session -e CAM_SESSION` -- never through buildImplementerWorkerArgv). Raised file-size ceilings for the 4 files this story grew (worker-argv.ts 169->193, worker-container.ts 350->357, worker-argv.test.ts 257->287, worker-container.test.ts 507->515) with a dated _ref note prepended.

officialDocsValidated.summary: Confirmed env(1) allows freely intermixing -u VAR (unset) options with NAME=VALUE (set) assignments before the command to invoke (e.g. `env -u EDITOR PATH=/energy -- prog`), matching the story notes' claim and this story's `env -u ... CAM_WORKER=1 claude ...` shape.
